scientific_question: Which signed head, aldehyde-tail, isocyanide-tail, and cross-tail descriptor shifts still separate the frozen MOG-semantic sampler from measured Ugi training lipids, and did joint semantic-density ranking reduce any of them?
nonclaims: This is a seed-0 train-fold-only failure-attribution diagnostic, not a held-out model claim.
Signed role-descriptor shifts diagnose structural distribution mismatch; they are not biological activity, formulation performance, synthesis success, or candidate-quality scores.
The diagnostic performs no training, generation, repair, retry, routing, oracle calls, or candidate selection.
Only unambiguous verified exact-L1 traces enter the role-descriptor analysis.
